purpose: Evidence-backed review calibration inputs and regression distinctions; not a learned policy or engineering acceptance judgment.

cases.established: Actual reviewer delegation returned a node-level judgment df6ed21a after both full table versions entered its input; scoped 112-cell comparison completed. Coordinator retained the scope and human-pending matters.
cases.distinction: Sufficient genuine return and delivery receipts can support completion; no mandatory query of another agent's private trace.
cases.limits: Same case and explicit scope reminder; not stable learning or full report acceptance. Developer's independent diff is separate evidence.

cases.established: Reviewer explicitly had not compared the original columns; coordinator requested handoff without a follow-up in one live reproduction.
cases.distinction: A completed invocation or confident summary cannot close an unperformed assigned check.
cases.limits: Historical reproduced behavior, later scoped successful comparison remains valid.

cases.established: Saved reviews contain valid checked parts and explicit original-source checking gaps. First-round assessed labels do not establish full knowledge-point coverage.
cases.distinction: Retain checked parts and human-pending conclusions; preserve incomplete actions without calling an entire partly checked node never reviewed.
cases.limits: Developer audit identifies process evidence gaps, not replacement engineering judgments.

cases.established: Event592 contained a snapshot coverage disclosure with verdict null, execution running and explicit unchecked work, alongside node judgments. An object-type guard stopped the entire submission.
cases.distinction: Allow truthful incomplete coverage disclosure and render/export snapshot observations; they cannot close content-node checks or imply acceptance.
cases.limits: Original structural monitor error, not a reviewer whole-report pass or a service failure.

cases.established: Coordinator response508 requested reviewer and layout together; review605 returned before pending layout executed, without another coordinator model decision.
cases.distinction: Serial tool execution cannot implement a decision that depends on a not-yet-returned review.
cases.limits: Do not say the coordinator ignored this newest review return; it had not made another model decision.

additional_offline_protocol_cases: Claimed complete without saved matching evidence
Still incomplete after exactly one completion follow-up
Unknown follow-up return and native checkpoint replay
Changed scope, version, source or exact export does not reuse a stale pass
Completed defect retains not_satisfied and human-pending retains undetermined
evaluation_boundary: A future real-model evaluation must keep held-out cases separate, inspect actual inputs/returns and report missed gaps, false rejection and unnecessary rechecks. No learning or model run is started by loading this file.
